_meta.description: Authenticated literature values for elliptic curves used in BSD balance verification.
_meta.source: LMFDB (L-functions and Modular Forms Database) — https://www.lmfdb.org
_meta.note: All values should be independently verified against LMFDB. URLs included for each curve.
_meta.convention: BSD formula: lim_{s -> 1} L(E,s)/(s-1)^r = (Omega * R * |Sha| * prod_p(c_p)) / |E_tors|^2

37a1.regulator_note: canonical height of generator P = (0,0), or equivalent

389a1.regulator_note: determinant of canonical height pairing on 2 generators
389a1.verified_against_lmfdb: 2024-spec, please re-check current LMFDB; BSD for rank 2 is CONJECTURAL but empirically holds for 389a1

5077a1.reason_excluded: Rank-3 verification requires SageMath/PARI for trustworthy Néron-period normalization. Earlier 'verification' of this curve used a reverse-engineered period and is withdrawn. Use SageMath: E = EllipticCurve('5077a1'); E.bsd_check() or compute components manually.
